title: Tiles Price per Square Foot in Pakistan: Floor, Wall, Roof and Clay
excerpt: What decides tiles price per square foot in Pakistan: floor, wall, roof, stone and clay rates, hidden costs and how to compare quotes fairly.
meta_title: Tiles Price per Square Foot in Pakistan Guide
meta_description: Tiles price per square foot in Pakistan depends on material, size, finish, city and date. Learn what drives rates and how to compare quotes fairly.
answer_box: The tiles price per square foot in Pakistan depends on material, size, finish, quantity, city and date, with fixing, wastage and labour added on top. Roof tiles are usually sold per piece. Convert every quote to one unit and ask for a dated written quote before budgeting.
ai_summary: Tile prices per square foot in Pakistan vary by material, size, finish, city and date, so printed rate lists go stale quickly. Floor, wall, stone, jali and roof tiles are each priced in different units, and fixing, wastage and labour sit outside the tile rate. Pak Clay Tiles, making clay tiles in Lahore since 1982, gives free samples and dated written quotes on WhatsApp.
author: Pak Clay Team

faqs.question: What is the price of tiles per square foot in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: There is no single figure. Price depends on material, size, finish, thickness, city and date, and tiles may be sold per piece, box or square foot. We do not print a rate; ask for a dated written quote with the unit stated.

faqs.question: Why do tile rates change so often in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Fuel, transport, exchange rates on imported tiles and seasonal demand all move rates. A list printed last month can be wrong today, so rely on a supplier quote that carries a date.

faqs.question: How is a roof tile price converted to per square foot?
faqs.answer: Khaprail roof tiles are usually counted per piece. Ask how many pieces cover one square foot for your profile and overlap, then multiply by the piece rate. Your supplier or roofer should confirm the count.

faqs.question: Are terracotta tiles cheaper or costlier than ceramic or stone?
faqs.answer: It depends on size, finish and handling, so no category is always cheaper. Compare tiles that suit the same job, converted to one unit, with wastage and fixing included.
